question: Which among the following festivals marks the birthday of a great Buddhist saint Je Tsongkhapa?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Galdan Namchot**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The festival that marks the birthday of the great Tibetan Buddhist saint Je **Tsongkhapa is Galdan Namchot.**
 
• This festival also marks the start of the **New Year celebrations in Ladakh, India.**
 
• **Je Tsongkhapa** was a famous** teacher of Tibetan Buddhism whose activities led to the formation of the Gelug school of Tibetan Buddhism.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Sarhul: **

 
 
• Sarhul is a **tribal festival celebrated by the ethnic groups in the Indian states of Jharkhand, Odisha, and Chhattisgarh.**
 
• This festival is celebrated to mark the beginning of the new year and the arrival of spring.
 
• Sarhul is celebrated with** traditional music and dance, the worship of village deities, and the sharing of a local drink made from fermented rice or salap.**
 
 
 
• **Losar:**
 
 
• Losar is the Tibetan word for** "New Year," and it is the most important holiday in Tibet and Tibetan** **border Indian states.**
 
• It is celebrated for** 15 days, with the main celebrations on the first three days.**
 
• Losar involves ceremonies, rituals, prayers, and cultural performances, and it is a time to spend with family and friends, to exchange gifts, and to eat special foods.
 
 
 
• **Tusu:**
 
 
• Tusu is a harvest festival celebrated in the Indian states of** Jharkhand, West Bengal, and Odisha.**
 
• The festival is observed on Makar Sankranti, which usually falls on **January 14th or 15th, marking the end of the winter season and the arrival of longer days.**
 
• Tusu involves singing traditional songs, dancing, and offering prayers to **Tusu, a folk deity, for a good harvest and prosperity in the coming year.**
